logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the compounds 1–5 was determined by using the shake-flask method of octanol/water phase partition. The compounds were dissolved in PBS (pH 7) at concentrations corresponding to absorbance of 0.4 at 488 nm. Octanol (500 μL) was added to a solution of the ruthenium compounds in PBS (500 μL) in 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes. The tubes were vigourously shaken for 10 min and the phases were separated by centrifugation at 2000 g for 5 min. The concentration of ruthenium compounds were determined by their absorbance at 488 nm and used to calculate log Poct/w.
